description: The drone vibrates constantly or when throttle increases, often with an audible high-pitched motor whine.
causes: D term set too high
RPM filter not enabled, or Bidirectional DSHOT not working
High gyro noise from a mount with no vibration dampening
Unbalanced or bent props

steps.title: Check Blackbox or watch motor noise
steps.description: Open Betaflight and go to the Motors tab, observe motor debug to see how much it's oscillating. Without blackbox, you can also feel it by holding the frame.

steps.title: Lower D term first
steps.description: Reduce d_roll and d_pitch by 5, then test-fly. Repeat until the oscillation is gone.
steps.action:
set d_roll = [current value - 5]
set d_pitch = [current value - 5]
save
steps.warning: Reducing D too much causes overshoot after flips/rolls

steps.title: Check RPM Filter
steps.description: Go to Betaflight Configuration → make sure MOTOR_STOP is off, verify the DSHOT protocol is correct, and enable Bidirectional DSHOT under ESC Telemetry.
steps.action:
set dshot_bidir = ON
set rpm_filter_harmonics = 3
save

steps.title: Inspect props and motor mounts
steps.description: Remove each prop one at a time and check if it's bent. Check that motor screws aren't loose, and that the stack mount is properly soft-mounted.
steps.warning: Even a slightly bent prop can cause abnormally high vibration

symptom: Propwash After Throttle Drop (drone shakes when throttle comes back up)
description: After diving and then bringing the throttle back up, the drone visibly shakes or wobbles, causing shaky video.
causes: I term accumulation during zero-throttle
Props flying through their own turbulent air (vortex ring state)
Not enough D term
iterm_relax not configured

steps.title: Enable iterm_relax
steps.description: Set iterm_relax to RP (Roll + Pitch) to stop I term accumulation at low throttle.
steps.action:
set iterm_relax = RP
set iterm_relax_type = SETPOINT
set iterm_relax_cutoff = 15
save

steps.title: Increase D term slightly
steps.description: Try increasing d_roll and d_pitch by 3-5. D term helps damp the shake after throttle comes back.
steps.action:
set d_roll = [current value + 3]
set d_pitch = [current value + 3]
save
steps.warning: Don't increase D so much that motors overheat — check motor temp right after landing from one battery

steps.title: Adjust throttle transition (if available)
steps.description: On BF 4.4+, try set throttle_boost = 5-10 to help motors punch out of the vortex faster.

symptom: Toilet Bowl / Yaw Drift (drone rotates or drifts in yaw on its own)
description: The drone slowly rotates around the yaw axis without stick input, or keeps rotating even after the stick returns to center.
causes: Yaw P set too high
Motor imbalance (bent shaft or worn bearing)
Frame imbalance, prop guard mounted on the wrong side
Yaw I set too low

steps.title: Lower Yaw P first
steps.description: Reduce p_yaw by 5, then test-hover in place and check if the drift is reduced.

steps.title: Check each motor's spin individually
steps.description: Open the Betaflight Motor tab, remove the props, and spin each motor one at a time — listen for noise and watch the shaft for wobble.
steps.warning: Caution! Never spin a motor with props still attached

steps.title: Check the frame is square
steps.description: Place the frame on a flat surface and check that the arms aren't twisted or misaligned. A warped frame makes tuning much harder.

symptom: Video Lines / Shaking / Interference (Video noise / Lines)
description: The FPV feed shows horizontal lines, flickering, or heavy static, especially when throttle increases.
causes: VTX and camera don't have a noise-filtering capacitor installed
FC power supply isn't filtered well enough
Video wire routed too close to a power wire
Ground loop between VTX and camera

steps.title: Add a capacitor at the battery pad
steps.description: Solder a 1000-2200μF 35V capacitor to the battery pad on the FC or PDB — positive lead to +, negative lead to -.
steps.warning: ⚠️ Watch polarity carefully. A reverse-connected capacitor can explode

steps.title: Add an LC filter or video filter
steps.description: Add an LC filter (1206 inductor + 470μF cap) between the FC and VTX to filter high-frequency noise from the ESC.

steps.title: Improve wire routing
steps.description: Route video/signal wires as far away as possible from power wires and ESC motor wires.

symptom: Motor Running Abnormally Hot After Flight
description: A motor is too hot to touch or smells burnt after just one battery. Anything above 60°C is considered too hot.
causes: D term set too high, causing the motor to oscillate constantly
Props too large or too high-pitch for that KV rating
Current draw exceeding the motor's rating
Worn motor bearing

steps.title: Lower D term immediately
steps.description: D term set too high causes constant motor oscillation, which generates a lot of heat. Reduce d_roll and d_pitch by 5-8.
steps.action:
set d_roll = [current value - 6]
set d_pitch = [current value - 6]
save
steps.warning: Test-fly after this change and check motor temp immediately after landing

steps.title: Check motor rating vs. props
steps.description: Check the motor's datasheet for max thrust with the props you're using. For example, a 1750KV motor is normally fine on 5" 4S — the same 1750KV motor on 6S will run very hot.
steps.warning: ⚠️ A motor that's overheated to the point of burning is permanently damaged

steps.title: Try a lower-pitch prop
steps.description: Switching from a high-pitch prop (e.g. 5148) to a lower-pitch one (e.g. 5045) will reduce current draw.
